evidence.orientation: The source and four-view Trellis witness preserve a low armored head-to-tail body axis. This cast uses the same normalized Trellis export convention as 719024: headward is raw glTF -Z.
evidence.mesh: One indexed triangle primitive, one opaque double-sided material, 153090 vertices and 129804 faces.
evidence.selection: Selected because its flattened shell plates, clustered legs, and broad lateral silhouette materially differ from 719024 while retaining a lawful axial registration.
evidence.limitation: This is a hand-registered second-cast reuse assay, not a generalized skeleton, autorig, or non-axial deformation contract.
